functions.name: GetCustomThreadPool
functions.docs:
If IsBuildThreadsafe() returns true, then this is the thread pool that is used to run the background task.
@return	The threadpool to run the task with

functions.name: IsDeterministic
functions.docs: Indicated that this plugin generates deterministic data. This is used for DDC verification

functions.name: GetDebugContextString
functions.docs: A string used to describe the data being generated. Typically the path to the object that it is generated from is sufficient.
